verdicts.reason: A keeps the quote larger and more legible on a clean left edge it shares with the logo. However, the backdrop circle rises close to the end of the quote and the attribution, and the SOLSTICE label on the can is unreadable. B is indented more and is more cramped. Its 'THE GROVE TASTING TEAM' attribution and the quote mark shrink to near-illegible size, and the can sits low near the bottom edge. Overall B reads as a weaker, smaller copy of the original.
